author: Frank Asante Van Laarhoven

search_closure.candidate_ordering: seeded generation order, route_id hospital_route_000 .. hospital_route_095
search_closure.early_termination_evidence: the candidate loop is `for i in range(args.budget)` with no break; the single break in that region caps recorded support failures at 5 within one candidate's inner sampling loop. Selection sets `selected` on the first passing candidate and continues, so the budget is exhausted regardless.
search_closure.verdict: the 96 candidates constitute the complete preregistered population under the frozen search budget and generation method

structure_of_the_failure.note: exactly the 7 candidates with >= 3 qualifying heading changes reached G5, and all 7 failed it. The generator predominantly produces straight corridor runs: 73 of 96 have zero qualifying turns.

why_the_remaining_gates_cannot_change_th.argument: every one of the 96 candidates already fails at least one hard required gate. G3, G4, G6, G7, G8 and G9 are additional REQUIRED gates under an all-must-pass admission rule, so adding them can only leave a candidate's failure unchanged or add a further failure. No monotone addition of required gates converts a FAIL into a PASS.
why_the_remaining_gates_cannot_change_th.therefore: re-running the Hospital route search after G3-G10 are implemented would consume Isaac time to re-derive a result already determined by the frozen artefact.
why_the_remaining_gates_cannot_change_th.dependency_disclosure: this argument is monotonicity, and it is sound. It does NOT establish that the two underlying verdicts are themselves correct -- see load_bearing_dependencies.

load_bearing_dependencies.note: the freeze rests on two independent verdicts, and they are not equally well supported. Recorded so a reader can see which one would have to be wrong for the conclusion to change.

G10_89_of_96.rests_on: pure route geometry -- heading-change counting on a decimated polyline
G10_89_of_96.strength: STRONG -- recomputable from the recorded candidate polylines without a simulator

G5_7_of_96.strength: WEAKER -- see gates/failures/F-G5-1.md, an unresolved two-order-of-magnitude disagreement between the PhysX reading and the planner's own map on these same 7 routes
G5_7_of_96.if_this_instrument_were_wrong: those 7 candidates would require re-adjudication and Hospital would not necessarily be NO_ADMISSIBLE_ROUTE. The other 89 would be unaffected.

claim_boundary.claim: no route in the preregistered BO-10 candidate population satisfies the frozen collection contract
does_not_claim: Hospital is physically incapable of long-horizon navigation
the Hospital scene is unsuitable for the research programme
claim_boundary.scope: the exact candidate-generation procedure, search budget, seed and frozen thresholds used in this experiment

what_a_future_experiment_may_do.permitted: a NEW preregistered collection experiment may define a different route population -- multi-leg routes, waypoint routes, a different generator or a different budget.
what_a_future_experiment_may_do.required: it must be preregistered before its candidates are evaluated, and it must be recorded as a separate experiment.
what_a_future_experiment_may_do.forbidden: it must not overwrite this result, and it must not be presented as a repair to it. Retrofitting a route population after seeing that the current one fails is the shape of rescuing a hypothesis rather than fixing a protocol.
what_a_future_experiment_may_do.observation_for_that_experiment: 73 of 96 candidates have zero qualifying heading changes, which says the current generator and the predeclared long-horizon objective are mismatched. That is a design observation, not a licence to amend this experiment.

provenance_caveat.meaning: the source run was made on a dirty worktree. The harness itself is pinned by harness_sha256 10c7b6aeb70668826159fd94eeeac3b0fbab2f8f8ef2cf3ba77e8386c171ed0e, and the harness sources have since been committed at 4e01580, so the executed harness text is recoverable. non_claims: The scene-wide traversability verdict is unchanged: Hospital remains NOT ADMISSIBLE scene-wide.
F-TWIN-1 remains open; no contact-physics claim rests on this result.

robustness_to_the_heading_counting_amend.what_changed: heading deltas are grouped into turn episodes rather than emitted on first threshold crossing
robustness_to_the_heading_counting_amend.direction_of_effect: counts can only merge downward, so the gate is strictly harder to pass
robustness_to_the_heading_counting_amend.argument: the 89 rejected with counts 0/1/2 stay below 3 because counts cannot rise; the 7 with counts 3/4/5 failed G5 regardless, and several would additionally fail G10 under the corrected rule. No candidate was admitted on the strength of an over-count, because no candidate was admitted.
robustness_to_the_heading_counting_amend.why_not_possible: the candidate polylines were not stored in the artefact; only the counts and turn lists were
